<thought>Using the list of available functional groups, the valid terms for the forward nitro‑to‑amine reduction are “nitro” (broken) and “primary amines” (formed). I will search the template catalog for templates that match a molecule containing the amine product (the sulfonamide) with these functional‑group criteria. This should return the template that, when applied retrosynthetically, gives the nitro precursor, and includes the mapped reaction SMILES and template ID.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "O=S(=O)(C1=CC(F)=CC=C1)Nc1ccc2c(c1)C(CCC3(CCC3)O3)=C(N2CCN(C(OC(C)(C)C)=O)CC2)C2=CC=CC=C2",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["nitro"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["primary amines"],
    "limit": 5
}
</action_input>
